note: Speakers are role labels. Adoption absent for a second consecutive week. Data migration attended but spoke for under a minute and gave no specifics.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Week three. The contract was due on the twenty-fourth. Platform, start there.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: We worked it on the twenty-fourth. It is not published. There is one open question on versioning that came back late in review.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: So it has missed. What is the new date?

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: I do not have one. It depends on the versioning answer and that sits with architecture.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: That is the third date I have been given on this. Field mapping has not moved since the sixth.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: The sixth of July?

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: The sixth of July. Three weeks with no transition on that ticket, and idempotency keys behind it.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: The versioning question is with me. I can answer it, but nobody had raised it to me as urgent.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: It is urgent. Integration, what is the effect if this runs another two weeks?

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: The release date is at risk. Not the milestone, the release. There is no other path to that mapping.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: I would push back slightly. The stubs are close to the shape of the final contract.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: Close is not the same as agreed. We are not writing production mapping against a guess.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Say that plainly for me, because the board has integration as green this week.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: We're not moving on that interface until platform give us the contract. Green is not where we are.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Then the board is wrong and I own that. Data migration.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: All fine our end.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Fine meaning the integrity fixes are done, or fine meaning nothing has caught fire?

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: Nothing has caught fire. I have to drop, sorry.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Reporting closed the rounding defect. Everything else is in flight.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Finance requests keep landing. I would still say we are keeping up.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Environment provisioning is finally moving, it went to in progress this week. UAT entry criteria are drafted.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: On the UAT environment for cycle two, that should be fine for cycle two, all being well. Nobody has confirmed the window.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Who is confirming it, and by when?

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Nobody, currently. That is the honest answer.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: The regression pack and the non-functional plan still have not moved. Three weeks on the plan now.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Adoption, second week running. Anyone heard anything?

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: Nothing. Their tickets are ticking over but I could not tell you what state the workstream is in.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Then that goes up as unknown, not as green. Board this afternoon, and I am changing integration.
